note: ML-210 rule A8 (WCAG 2.5.1 / 2.5.7): every swipe or drag gesture in the app must have a single-tap alternative. scripts/a11y-audit.mjs fails on any wire*Swipe/*GrabHandle/*Drag function (or draggable="true" list) not listed here, or listed with no alternative.

gestures.gesture: swipe a Quick-play / metronome bar left to reveal Delete
drag a bar's grab handle up/down to reorder
gestures.alternative: Bar ⋮ menu > Move up / Move down (qpBarMenu)

gestures.gesture: swipe a Flow block left to reveal Delete
drag a Flow block's grab handle to reorder
gestures.alternative: Block ⋮ menu > Move up / Move down (flowBlockMenu)

gestures.gesture: shared helper behind both grab handles above
swipe a fermata/pause row left to reveal Delete
swipe a tempo ramp row left to reveal Delete
drag the ☰ handle to reorder challenges and practice-list items
gestures.alternative: tap the ☰ handle > Move up / Move down (reorderMenu); arrow keys on the handle
